assumptions.beginningYearDependency: unknown; one qualifying child assumed only for K/I/1 illustration
assumptions.mainTHRTiming: Before December, with December alternative shown
assumptions.designMonths: March–December projected, ten months; actual receipts unknown

assumptions.bookCostCase: IDR 10000000 genuine documented deductible costs assumed for comparison, not proven by budget
assumptions.reserveChoice: 35% cash budget, not tax rate/ceiling; PPh 25 obligations unknown

calculationQualifications.inventory: All 81 retained inventory outcomes preserved in data; not every auxiliary outcome is public prose
calculationQualifications.mechanicalNoDesignBaseline: The P=0 combined-salary baseline is an arithmetic counterfactual, NOT the lawful KK salary-only-wife-exception comparison
calculationQualifications.PHMTExtraFields: Auxiliary proportional-allocation illustrations rounded to two decimals; not a confirmed filing-rounding convention or actual personal bill
calculationQualifications.publicTables: Complete load-bearing payroll, allowances/status, marginal brackets, norm/books/final comparison, KK household illustration, reserve and filing tables

provenance.calculationMethod: Independent integer/Decimal arithmetic in a scoped staging check, without executing any source script. All 81 inventory fields compared against the retained author and final reviewer results, and public table values checked against the recalculation.

datePolicy: Research/source access dates are the retained 2026-11-08 dates. Local authoring does not constitute a network refresh. No new source acquisition; links not live-retested.
uncertainties: Rina is hypothetical, not user-submitted facts. Actual family KK/PH/MT/HB and NPWP/DUK, spouse income/credits, beginning-year dependency/residency and actual annual balance unknown.
Working-wife TK/0 category A payroll is separate from conditional K/I/1 household PTKP. Actual taxable payroll, BPJS-related benefits/contributions, THR timing and BPA1 may change the illustration.

Existing calendar-year 2026 NPPN notice deadline 2026-03-31 is not measured from freelance start. Correct tax-unit registration/notice and KLU remain unknown. Regulatory norm 32% conflicts with official explainer 46%.

PP 55 is amended by PP 20/2026 effective 2026-04-22. Former seven-year individual limit deleted. Professional classification, business/family turnover, prior elections and transition facts remain unknown.

Zero final tax on IDR 60m requires eligible business and unused available first-IDR 500m exemption. No automatic second KK-wife allowance. Full annual household result for wife-owned below-exemption final business plus salary is not established.
Invented husband's salary and credits illustrate KK aggregation only; PH/MT allocation is not two independent brackets. No assessed personal balance or guaranteed range.
35% reserve is a cash choice, not tax rate/ceiling or substitute for PPh 25. Actual instalment duties, receipts and deductible costs unknown; budget costs are not proved deductions.
2027 delay interest is unknown, not permanently 2% monthly. Future forms/attachment IDs, certificate-delivery deadline, concessions and OSS/NIB licensing remain unconfirmed.
Machine-assisted Indonesian, not native-certified. No network/browser/build/integration/publication/account access/contact/filing/purchase/commit. Parent owns combined review and rendered validation.
